title: Burbank & Griffith Park Private E-Bike Ride
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Suitable for parties of any size and any ability level, this is a visually imposing ride, mostly on paved roads closed to traffic. You'll bask in the California sun as we traverse up and down gentle hillside grades, taking in amazing views of the San Fernando Valley, downtown LA, and Hollywood basin. Points of interest along the ride include the renowned and historic Griffith Observatory. Snacks and water provided. Free parking.
